title: 逐模型波形误差 / Waveform error by model
alt_text: Four panels compare every method for each model in Main and LowerSNR, separately for Direct and Split. Points are finite-row means, vertical lines span the empirical 10th–90th percentiles. Numerical failures with finite scores remain included; nonfinite counts are explicit.

title: Direct局部保幅代价 / Local amplitude costs (Direct)
alt_text: Six panels display paired absolute changes in event amplitude, weak-event, pinchout-tail, AVO intercept, AVO gradient and fault-neighborhood errors. Small circles show model means, larger method symbols show the equal-model average. Missing and inapplicable entries are counted together and retained in source data.

title: 实际最差候选案例 / Actual worst candidate case: 道集 / gather
alt_text: The actual largest finite RelativeError among the three declared candidate Split branches is shown beside its same-observation Frozen Split, truth and observation. Selection uses maximum error, including finite solver-failed results, with deterministic tie breaks; it does not choose an attractive example. The key, status and errors are printed. All panels share an unclipped absolute amplitude maximum.

title: 实际最差候选案例 / Actual worst candidate case: 波形与频谱 / waveform and spectrum
alt_text: For the same actual worst finite candidate Split case, fixed traces 1, 6 and 11 show the full-time raw waveforms and unsmoothed full-Nyquist spectra of truth, observation, the candidate and its matched Frozen Split. The case identifiers, solver status and candidate/Frozen errors are printed. Trace choice is fixed rather than selected by the appearance of failure.
